-58.38160,-34.60370.name: INASE — seed royalties and farm-saved seed
-58.38160,-34.60370.desc: Argentina’s seed institute, at the centre of a long dispute over whether farmers may save seed and what royalties are owed. Argentina is where the seed-saving argument has been most fiercely contested, because a large share of farmers did save seed and companies attempted to charge on the harvest instead.

-58.38160,-34.60370.name: ABRE-BIO
-58.38160,-34.60370.state: Buenos Aires — Argentina, Brazil, Paraguay and Uruguay
-58.38160,-34.60370.desc: Argentina, Brazil, Paraguay and Uruguay set up a joint biosafety network in June 2024, building on a 2022 Argentina–Brazil agreement that lets one dossier be submitted to CONABIA and CTNBio together. The stated aim is synchronised approvals and lower regulatory cost. The effect is that four countries holding a large share of the world's engineered soybean and maize now assess it as one bloc, so a decision taken in one of them is harder to contest in the others — the objection has to be made before the dossiers converge, not after.

-58.38160,-34.60370.name: CELMA v. the Intacta approval
-58.38160,-34.60370.state: Buenos Aires — Corte Suprema de Justicia de la Nación
-58.38160,-34.60370.desc: An Argentine environmental law centre complained to the Supreme Court about how a herbicide-tolerant soybean had been approved, on two specific grounds: that the approval had not gone through the public consultation Argentine law requires, and that no environmental impact study had been carried out. The grounds matter more than the outcome. Most challenges to an engineered crop argue about the organism; this one argued about the PROCEDURE, and a procedural defect does not need a scientific dispute to establish. It is the same route the Mexican collective action took to its precautionary measure, and it is available wherever a country's own law promises a consultation it did not hold.

-118.49600,34.01000.name: The ODIN
-118.49600,34.01000.desc: Sells gene-editing kits, engineered bacteria and frog-muscle-growth injections by post, to anyone. Its founder injected himself with a CRISPR construct on a livestream in 2017. California later required such kits to carry a warning that they are not for self-administration — a law that exists because of this one shop.

-122.40300,37.76200.name: Wildtype
-122.40300,37.76200.desc: Cultivated salmon, cleared by the FDA in 2025. Fish sidestep two objections aimed at cultivated red meat: the environmental case is about overfishing rather than land, and the product is eaten raw in sushi, where the texture problem that defeats a cultivated steak barely arises.
